text_block_list.text: While passing by the front of the dorm—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Some juicy meat
arrived from Mom and Dad!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Meat in the USA is so sizzlin' and juicy!
The meat juices taste absolutely delicious, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So sharing makes everyone happy!
It's the spirit of omotenashi hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're coming to the party too, right, Trainer?
Spread your arms wide, and soar into the sky of meat—
Sky High, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Take... care? Not take off?
Um... "take care of yourself"?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes, that is true. Eating too much is not good.
If I eat too much, I will become
marbled beef... yes."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
OK! Let's keep it to a little bit then.
We'll hold back with just a 2 or 3-pound steak, yes!

Taiki Shuttle showed some restraint, yet still ate plenty.
Her stomach full, she seemed revitalized with energy.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's take off! It's a contest to see who can eat more, *dees*!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you eat, there's plenty of meat,
so it's fine! It was sent over in a cargo shipment.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Today, we're all going for dine-and-dash? No, eat-until-we-drop?
Let's eat until our bellies burst, shall we!

I charged into the mountain of meat together with Taiki Shuttle.
My stomach didn't burst, but my weight certainly did.
